messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up team: were seeing intermittent p99 latency spikes with CUDA 12.2 on long context jobs in APAC. Vendor posted a micro-release they claim fixes nvlink handshake races. Need partner alignment for marketplace image pin + hotfix rollout.
Brandon K.: Can you repro reliably? Need logs and the exact driver + kernel combo.
Aisha Patel: Repro with our long-form prompt set (prompt-suite: longform-apac) when token count > 1.5k. Error rate small (~0.5%) but p99 jumps ~2-3x. Running on image gpu-runtime:2026-03-15-driver-535.86.
Celine Park: Is this on Dedicated + Marketplace or only marketplace images?
Aisha Patel: Observed on both. Dedicated fleets using the same base image in ap-southeast1.
Diego Martinez: Vendor Liaison says they shipped 535.86.1 internally. We need: signed driver artifact, kernel logs, and partner smoke cert.
Ethan Wu: Proposal: 1) vendor publishes signed 535.86.1 blob; 2) we build `redwood/marketplace:gpu-2026-03-20-driver-53586-1-apac-canary`; 3) run canary 1% for 90m with perf + correctness checks; 4) roll forward if green. Rollback tag pre-staged.
Brandon K.: Who owns the canary automation? I can trigger but want documented rollback steps.
Vendor Liaison: Partner SI available 23:00-02:00 SGT to assist. Prefer single maintenance window covering ap-northeast and ap-southeast overlap.
Aisha Patel: 23:00 SGT / 00:00 JST works for APAC overlap. I'll schedule.
Celine Park: I'll create the runbook and include the exact smoke commands.
Diego Martinez: Smoke commands:
```
# smoke run for canary
docker run --rm redwood/gpu-runtime:gpu-2026-03-20-driver-53586-1-apac-canary 
  /bin/sh -c "python -m rwi.smoke --profile=apac-quant --tokens=2000 --concurrency=4"
# health check
curl -sSf https://canary.ap-southeast1.redwood.internal/healthz
# collect logs if failures
journalctl -u nvidia-driver -n 200 --no-pager > /tmp/nvidia-journal.log
dmesg -T > /tmp/dmesg.log
```
Ethan Wu: Perf gates: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms, error-rate < 0.1% otherwise abort. Also run regression harness prompt-suite:apac-critical to ensure output stability.
Brandon K.: I'll capture logs and upload to partner ticket if we see oops. Add rollback triggers: if error-rate >0.2% for 15m OR p95 > baseline*1.3, auto-rollback.
Vendor Liaison: Partner will run residency tests during the 1% and provide signed artifacts and test outputs within 30m after window.
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: #DEPLOY-9876. Canary scheduled 2026-03-20T15:00Z (23:00 SGT).
Aisha Patel: Final items: pre-stage revert image `redwood/marketplace:gpu-prepatch-2026-03-15-driver-53586`, verify KMS signing keys, and update SLA notes.
Celine Park: I'll post the runbook link in #eng-sre and the vendor ticket. Oncall: @Brandon K., @Ethan Wu, @Diego Martinez please confirm.
Brandon K.: Confirmed.
Ethan Wu: Confirmed.
Diego Martinez: Confirmed.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all. I'll ping the SI contact 1h before the window and close here until the runbook is live.
